content: make a cat that is also a toaster

Your cat-toaster is built: a studded orange cat whose body is the toaster — ears, whiskers, eyes, nose, paws and tail, with a side lever, a red heat dial, a crumb tray and a power cord. I read the two toast slots and the toast slices back in the place and confirmed they exist at the front of the body (the earlier camera view was just too far away to show them), and the slices have a pop-up animation with a click sound wired to clicking them — I did not play-test the click myself, so try it in Studio to see the slices bounce up.

What I did not check: that there are 2 toasts.
